correctness.rationale: The four-factor certificate is necessary. It is sufficient for all short factors via the local 01/10 contexts and pure-run placements; all long factors have occurrence-union core containing each internal 10 boundary by periodic shifts. Set-product enumeration handles a,b>=2 and singleton-run boundary cases. Pair coordinates give the distance multiset. The verifier exhaustively tests 100 parameter triples and separate literal occurrence tests 2100 pairs; these are finite corroboration, not the infinite proof.
